# Contributing to Modus Bootstrap

Thanks for helping out. Please read the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) first.

## Issues

- Search existing issues before opening a new one.
- For bugs, include a reduced test case, steps to reproduce, and your browser and OS.
- For features, explain the use case. Changes should fit the Modus design system (see [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md)).

## Pull requests

1. Fork the repo and create a branch off `main`.
2. Run `npm install`.
3. Edit the source files only: Sass in `scss/`, JavaScript in `js/src/`, and docs in `site/src/content/docs/`. Don't commit `dist/` or `js/dist/`.
4. Run `npm start` to preview the docs locally, and `npm test` before you push.
5. Open a pull request against `main` with a clear title and description. Keep it focused on one change.

Ask in an issue before starting anything large.
